notes: Checked against the author's License and source page. The book may be used under the GFDL or CC BY-SA 3.0 United States, at the user's choice (not CC BY-SA 2.5 as claimed); Ceder takes CC BY-SA 3.0 US, which allows commercial use, so a paid app may show a passage with the credit in attribution, and what Ceder changes stays under that licence. The author says he tried to use only shareable material but may have slipped, so a figure or quotation from elsewhere in the book needs its own check. The book is a PDF; its LaTeX source is on gitlab.com, which wasn't read. The bank's agents don't read it and nothing from it goes into the bank.
